sections.h2: Rabi and summer crops now supply more than half of India's foodgrains

chart.title: Rabi and summer share of foodgrain output rose from 36% to 53%
chart.sub: Share of India's foodgrain production, %. Summer counted with rabi.

sections.means: Rabi and summer crops grew from 36% to 53% of India's foodgrains between 1966-67 and 2025-26.
sections.todo: Plan procurement, storage and warehouse credit around the rabi harvest months, when arrivals concentrate.

sections.h2: Rabi and summer land yields more foodgrain per hectare than kharif

chart.title: In 2025-26, rabi and summer yielded 3,013 kg a hectare, kharif 2,323 kg

sections.means: Rabi and summer land also gives more grain per hectare, mainly because most rabi crops are irrigated.
sections.todo: Track kharif yields closely, since kharif output grew mainly through yield rather than land.

sections.h2: Rabi and summer foodgrain area grew 32% while kharif area stayed flat

chart.title: Over twenty years, kharif foodgrain area was flat and rabi and summer area rose 32%
chart.sub: Change in foodgrain area, 2003-06 to 2023-26 (three-year averages).

sections.means: Kharif land has not grown, while rabi and summer foodgrain area rose 32% over the same twenty years.
sections.todo: Watch groundwater and canal supply for the summer season, since these crops depend on them in the hottest months.
